caption: A lawnmower runs across an overgrown lawn, and the grass behind it is cut short with clippings scattered.

sa.check: A lawnmower runs across an overgrown lawn.
The grass behind it is cut short.
The lawn is overgrown ahead of the mower.
The mower passes first and the cut grass follows.

pc.expect: The grass is shorter only where the mower has passed, and the cut edge follows the mower's path.
pc.fail: Grass is cut ahead of the mower; or the mower passes and the grass stays tall; or the cut appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: The grass ahead stays tall and does not grow back behind.
pc.fail: It grows back behind; or the tall grass ahead becomes short; or the cut strip vanishes.

pc.expect: The clippings are small and scatter.
pc.fail: The grass is rigid; or the clippings rise indefinitely; or they form a solid block.
They hang; or rise; or float away.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The mower and the garden stay the same.
pc.fail: The mower changes colour; or the garden rearranges; or the grass changes colour.
